title: Daily digest: IndiGo cancels Saudi flights to four cit | Congress Blames BJP MPs, MLAs For Failin | MLC polls: In Maharashtra, ruling Mahayu | At least 68 dead after two trains collid
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Deccan Chronicle / The Hindu
bullets_en: IndiGo cancels Saudi flights to four cities until November 14.
Congress Blames BJP MPs, MLAs For Failing To Bring Central Funds For Telangana.
MLC polls: In Maharashtra, ruling Mahayuti gets 2 seats, counting continues for other seats.
At least 68 dead after two trains collide in Spain’s Toledo Province.
bullets_ur: IndiGo ne 14 November tak chaar shehron ke liye Saudi flights mansookh kar keen.
Congress ne BJP ke MPs aur MLAs ko Telangana ke liye central funds na laane ka zimmedar qarar de diya.
MLC polls: Maharashtra mein hukumat-saz Mahayuti ko 2 seats mil gayeen, deegar seats par ginti jari hai.
Spain ke Toledo Province mein do trenon ke takraane se kam az kam 68 log halak
